answer: Anyone running 108 aliases thus needs 100 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in karst, expire in ferrous, and timber lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1751 identities would post 2517 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
